description: This PHP source file defines classes and methods for a CSV database driver as part of the ADOdb database abstraction layer. It includes connection handling, query execution, and metadata functions specific to CSV file interactions.

classes.name: ADODB_csv
classes.description: Implements a CSV-based database connection for ADOdb, handling connection, query execution, transaction support, and metadata.

classes.name: ADODBRecordset_csv
classes.description: Represents a recordset specifically for CSV data, extending ADORecordSet.

methods.name: _insertID
methods.description: Returns the last insert ID for the current connection.

methods.name: _affectedrows
methods.description: Returns the number of affected rows from the last query.

methods.name: MetaDatabases
methods.description: Meta-database support, currently returns false indicating unsupported.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes connection to a CSV source via HTTP URL.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Returns metadata about table columns, currently unsupported.

methods.name: SelectLimit
methods.description: Executes a limited select query with optional offset and caching.

methods.name: _Execute
methods.description: Executes an SQL query, replacing parameters if necessary, and returning a recordset.
